title: Consumer Prioritize Experiences Over Materials in Summer 2026
discussion_signal: KPMG frames constrained household budgets as selective reallocation rather than uniform retreat: consumers cut or reshape some spending to protect travel and meaningful experiences, while AI trip planning moves earlier into the decision path. This adds a discretionary-choice and technology-mediated discovery signal.
linked_research_question: How do households protect meaning and experience under budget pressure, and how does AI alter the route by which discretionary choices are formed?
limits: Consumer intention is not realized spending
The post does not establish how trends vary across all income groups
Public search discovery is not a platform-native Creator/API export
